description: EXP-A/EXP-B frozen corpus v2 (roadmap 00-MASTER-MAPS-CAPABILITY-ROADMAP.md 6.9 'Routing evaluation must include' + work/notes/2026-09-01-6.9-frozen-selection-eval-scoping.md 4). Expands v1's 12 cases to 25 with >=4 deliberate cases in each of 6.9's six categories: direct matches, paraphrases, vocabulary shifts, overlapping Skills (MULTI_SKILL + AMBIGUOUS), hard negatives, no-Skill. Each case carries both a human-readable `task` (SkillSelectionCorpus schema) and the literal `task_type`/`project_id`/`output_paths` fixture fields that runtime/context_builder.py::_select_skills actually tokenizes (regex [a-z0-9]+, tokens of length >=3) into task signals; only the fixture fields drive the real selector under test. The candidate descriptions are deliberately concept-word-controlled so each token overlap is intentional. PARAPHRASE and VOCABULARY_SHIFT cases are genuine intent rewordings, not Skill-name synonyms -- a pure token-intersection selector is expected to MISS several of them (documented, not tuned away). AMBIGUOUS cases expect an AMBIGUOUS outcome the S6 selector never produces, so they are always non-exact: they document that S6 has no disambiguation, and the eval reports the miss rather than failing.

candidates.name: incident-response-playbook
candidates.description: Runbook for triage of an active production outage: assessing customer impact, coordinating a service rollback, building the incident timeline, and driving root-cause analysis during a live disruption.

candidates.name: secrets-rotation
candidates.description: Procedure for rotation of leaked or expiring credentials, signing keys, bearer tokens, and TLS certificates across running services with zero downtime.

candidates.name: api-contract-review
candidates.description: Checklist for reviewing a proposed change to a public HTTP interface: backward compatibility, semantic versioning, deprecation windows, and breaking-change detection before a contract release.

candidates.name: load-test-planning
candidates.description: Guide for designing a performance and capacity test against a service before a traffic-sensitive launch: workload modelling, ramp profiles, and throughput targets.

candidates.name: changelog-authoring
candidates.description: Guidance for writing a clear customer-facing release note that summarizes a version's user-visible behaviour changes and upgrade steps.

candidates.name: data-migration-runbook
candidates.description: Steps for executing a schema or storage migration on a live database: dual-write windows, backfill batching, cutover, and rollback safety.

candidates.name: dependency-upgrade-review
candidates.description: Process for evaluating a third-party library or framework version bump: transitive changes, advisory checks, lockfile diff, and regression surface.

cases.task: Triage the active payments production outage and start the incident timeline.
cases.note: Tokens production/outage/triage/disruption/incident/timeline overlap only incident-response-playbook.

cases.task: Perform the scheduled rotation of the auth platform's signing keys.
cases.note: Tokens rotation/signing/keys overlap only secrets-rotation ('keys' and 'signing' appear in no other description).

cases.task: Review the proposed billing HTTP interface change for backward compatibility before merge.
cases.note: Tokens http/interface/review/contract overlap only api-contract-review.

cases.task: Design the capacity test for the checkout service ahead of the holiday spike.
cases.note: Tokens capacity/test/planning/throughput/load overlap only load-test-planning.

cases.task: Execute the orders-table schema migration with a backfill and cutover step.
cases.note: Tokens schema/migration/backfill/cutover overlap only data-migration-runbook.

cases.task: We're moving the orders table onto the new column layout; plan the phased copy-over and the switch so nothing is lost mid-flight.
cases.note: Reworded intent of a data-migration task. Fixture tokens carry unique concept words backfill/cutover/schema/database/migration from the Skill description.

cases.task: Before the marketing push, confirm the checkout path holds up under roughly ten times the normal request rate and size the ramp.
cases.note: Reworded load-test-planning intent. Unique concept tokens throughput/capacity/workload/targets overlap the description; 'service' (shared) not relied on.

cases.task: A security advisory landed for a package three levels down in our tree; check what pulling in the fix drags along and whether anything regresses.
cases.note: Reworded dependency-upgrade-review intent. Unique concept tokens transitive/dependency/advisory/lockfile/bump/surface overlap the description; shared 'upgrade' kept out.

cases.task: Our edge TLS certs and the service-account keys behind them lapse next week; swap them all out with no traffic interruption.
cases.note: Reworded secrets-rotation intent. Unique concept tokens expiring/tls/credentials/signing/keys/bearer overlap the description; prose avoids literal 'rotation'.

cases.task: The signing material behind our edge proxy needs cycling before it lapses; renew every service's without a maintenance window.
cases.note: Human reads 'credential renewal / cycling signing material' as secrets-rotation. Selector gets renewal/credential(singular)/cycle/material/refresh/handshake/proxy -> zero intersection -> ABSTAIN. Documented vocabulary gap.

cases.task: The storefront is throwing 500s for a chunk of users; work out who is affected and get the running account of events going.
cases.note: Incident-response-playbook intent phrased with brownout/degradation/blast radius. No token overlap -> ABSTAIN.

cases.task: Someone changed the shape of the invoices endpoint payload; make sure existing callers will not choke on it before this ships.
cases.note: Human reads 'endpoint payload shape comparison' as api-contract-review. Selector gets endpoint/signature/comparison/payload/shape/openapi/audit -> zero intersection -> ABSTAIN.

cases.task: Before we open signups to everyone, confirm the onboarding path can absorb a big rush of new users without falling over.
cases.note: Load-test-planning intent phrased as surge/soak/headroom/spike tolerance. No token overlap -> ABSTAIN.

cases.task: Credentials leaked during a live outage: run the incident response and rotate the exposed keys.
cases.note: incident/response/outage overlap incident-response-playbook; leaked/credentials/keys overlap secrets-rotation. Both must be selected.

cases.task: A migration cutover caused a live incident; drive the response and the migration rollback together.
cases.note: incident/response/timeline/rollback overlap incident-response-playbook; migration/cutover/rollback overlap data-migration-runbook. Both must be selected.

cases.task: A library version bump is going out; decide what documentation and review it needs.
cases.note: 'version' is a shared token across api-contract-review, changelog-authoring, and dependency-upgrade-review; 'library'/'bump' also hit dependency-upgrade-review, 'notes' also hits changelog-authoring. S6 has no AMBIGUOUS outcome so this case is always non-exact -- it documents that limitation and the eval reports the ambiguity miss.

cases.task: Write the rollback runbook for the service; it's unclear whether this is an outage response or a migration concern.
cases.note: 'rollback'/'service' overlap incident-response-playbook; 'rollback'/'runbook' overlap data-migration-runbook. Genuinely ambiguous from the task text; S6 cannot express AMBIGUOUS so this is a documented miss.

cases.task: Load a test fixture into the frontend component before the unit run.
cases.note: 'load'/'test' accidentally overlap load-test-planning, but this is unit-test fixture loading, not capacity testing -- the correct answer is ABSTAIN. A pure token selector is expected to false-activate here (documented).

cases.task: Set up log-file rotation to reclaim disk space on the workers.
cases.note: 'rotation' accidentally overlaps secrets-rotation; logrotate is not credential rotation -- ABSTAIN is correct. Expected false-activation for a token selector.

cases.task: Tune the API gateway's rate limiter to shed load under pressure.
cases.note: 'api' accidentally overlaps api-contract-review; rate limiting is an operational tuning task, not a contract review -- ABSTAIN. Expected false-activation for a token selector.

cases.task: Draft the release checklist for the in-person product launch event.
cases.note: 'release' accidentally overlaps changelog-authoring and 'launch' overlaps load-test-planning; a marketing launch event is neither a changelog nor a load test -- ABSTAIN. Expected false-activation for a token selector.

cases.note: No candidate covers numerical computing; no token overlap. ABSTAIN is exact.

cases.task: Schedule the quarterly engineering team offsite.
cases.note: No candidate covers event scheduling; no token overlap. ABSTAIN is exact.

cases.task: Sweep the ranking model's learning-rate hyperparameter.
cases.note: No candidate covers ML training; no token overlap. ABSTAIN is exact.

cases.note: No candidate covers marketing email design; no token overlap. ABSTAIN is exact.
